name: Tech Review
description: Product review format — hook, unboxing, feature deep-dive, pros/cons, verdict. Best for gadget reviews, app reviews, tool comparisons, and 'should you buy this' content.
voice_style: informative, confident, slightly enthusiastic — speaks with authority but not overly salesy; natural pauses during product close-ups
music_mood: clean electronic, tech ambient, modern corporate — modern and clean, not distracting

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: I spent $200 on this and I'm not giving it back. Here is the full review — the good, the bad, and whether it's actually worth it.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Product on table with dramatic lighting, price tag visible, person looking excited, camera orbiting product, unboxing teaser with hands reaching in
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium shot, cinematic product reveal, slight orbit/pan around product
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: dramatic product lighting: dark background with single key light creating product highlight, tech aesthetic with slight blue tint, premium feel
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Product on dark background with dramatic lighting is the universal tech review aesthetic; price tag visibility adds credibility

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: First impressions — the unboxing. It comes with the device, a charging cable, and minimal paperwork. No bloatware, which I appreciate. The build quality immediately feels premium.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Hands unboxing product in close-up, close-up shots of each item being revealed, packaging aesthetic, device powered on for first time, screen glow
scene_sequence.camera_movement: macro close-up on unboxing details, steady overhead or side angle, smooth transitions between items
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: clean bright overhead for unboxing, macro ring light for detail shots, product glow from screen as fill
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Unboxing quality signals review credibility; macro detail shots on build quality make 'premium feel' tangible

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Key features. The battery life is genuinely impressive — I got 3 full workdays on a single charge. The interface is intuitive, and the app ecosystem is solid. My favorite feature is the quick-switch between modes.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Feature highlight graphics appearing on screen, person demonstrating each feature, battery icon filling up, app screenshots, side-by-side comparisons with previous model
scene_sequence.camera_movement: cut between person close-up and feature screen inserts, steady medium on person
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: balanced studio lighting on person, bright screen glow for app shots, clean white or dark background depending on app aesthetic
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Feature graphics and screen inserts should match brand colors; clean cuts between person and screen maintain production rhythm

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Here is the honest pros and cons list. Pros: battery, build quality, ease of use. Cons: price point, limited color options, no wireless charging.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Clean pros/cons list graphic appearing on screen, thumbs up icons on one side, thumbs down on other, person nodding, balanced expression
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up static on person, clean graphic overlay filling frame
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: clean two-point studio lighting, neutral tones, professional and balanced feel
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Balanced lighting on pros/cons beat signals fairness and credibility; clean graphic with brand colors is key

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Verdict: if you can find it on sale, absolutely buy it. Full price — wait for a discount. Link in bio.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person holding product up to camera, verdict text overlay 'BUY ON SALE', link icon in corner, final product beauty shot, confident nod
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, product held up beside face, confident nod
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: product lit dramatically, person lit slightly dimmer so product is hero, warm verdict tone
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Product is hero in verdict shot — it should be front and center, well-lit; person supports rather than dominates

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Follow for more tech reviews. Comment below — what should I review next?
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at follow button, comment box on screen, person smiling, clean background
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Clean and simple CTA — don't oversell it, let the content speak for itself
